Specialized required courses An Introduction to Jurisprudence Constitutional Law Principles of Civil Law1 Principles of Civil Law2 Chinese Legal History Commercial Law (Introduction, Corporation Law And Partnership Law) General Principles of Criminal Law Special Principles of Criminal Law Civil Procedure Law Intellectual Property Law Criminal Procedure Law Survey of Economic Law Elements of Jurisprudence Administrative Law And Procedure Public International Law Private International Law International Economic Law Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 2.Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5,without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree studyneed to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen. 5. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves.
